# Google Business Profile

Manage Google Business Profile accounts, locations, reviews, media, posts, performance, and verification workflows.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/google-business-profile/.

## Actions

- **Accept Invitation**: Accept a pending Google Business Profile account invitation and grant the connected user its offered access.
- **Batch Get Locations** (read-only): Return multiple legacy Google Business Profile Location resources belonging to one account in a single request.
- **Complete Verification**: Submit a PIN to complete a pending non-automatic Google Business Profile verification.
- **Create Account**: Create a location-group or user-group account.
- **Create Local Post**: Publish a customer-facing standard post, event, offer, or alert for a Google Business Profile location.
- **Create Location**: Create a merchant-owned Business Profile location.
- **Create Media**: Create and publish a customer-facing media item for a Google Business Profile location from a publicly reachable URL or an existing Google…
- **Create Place Action Link**: Create a public action link, such as an appointment or ordering URL, for a Google Business Profile location.
- **Decline Invitation**: Permanently decline a pending Google Business Profile account invitation.
- **Delete Local Post**: Permanently delete a local post from a Google Business Profile location.
- **Delete Location**: Permanently delete an API-deletable Business Profile location.
- **Delete Media**: Permanently delete merchant-owned media from a Google Business Profile location.
- **Delete Place Action Link**: Permanently delete a public Google Business Profile place-action link.
- **Delete Review Reply**: Permanently remove the merchant's public reply from a Google Business Profile review.
- **Find Chains** (read-only): Search Google Business Profile chains by display name, or return one chain by its exact chain resource name.
- **Generate Verification Token**: Generate a Google Business Profile instant verification token for an unverified listing identified by its final location ID.
- **Get Accounts** (read-only): List one page of Business Profile accounts accessible to the connected Google user, or return one exact account when account_name is…
- **Get Categories** (read-only): Search one page of localized Google Business Profile categories, or fetch up to 100 exact stable category resource names in one batch.
- **Get Daily Metrics** (read-only): Return one or more daily Google Business Profile performance metrics over an inclusive date range, normalized into one list of metric time…
- **Get Follower Metadata** (read-only): Return the total follower count for a verified Google Business Profile location connected to Google Maps.
- **Get Food Menus** (read-only): Return food menus for an eligible Google Business Profile location, optionally restricted to top-level fields by a read mask.
- **Get Google-Updated Location** (read-only): Return Google's consumer-facing version of a Business Profile location and field masks describing differences and pending merchant changes.
- **Get Local Posts** (read-only): List one page of local posts for a Google Business Profile location, or return one exact post when post_name is supplied.
- **Get Location** (read-only): Return selected merchant-managed fields for one Business Profile location.
- **Get Location Attributes** (read-only): Return either merchant-set or Google-displayed attributes for one Google Business Profile location, preserving attribute identifiers and…
- **Get Lodging** (read-only): Return merchant-set hotel lodging data or Google's displayed lodging data and the fields Google changed.
- **Get Media** (read-only): List one page of merchant or customer-contributed media for a Google Business Profile location, or return one exact media item.
- **Get Notification Setting** (read-only): Return an account's Google Pub/Sub topic and enabled Business Profile notification types.
- **Get Place Action Links** (read-only): List one page of a Google Business Profile location's place-action links, or return one exact link when link_name is supplied.
- **Get Reviews** (read-only): Return one exact Google Business Profile review, one page for a verified location, or one account-batch page across up to 50 verified…
- **Get Voice of Merchant State** (read-only): Return whether a Google Business Profile location has merchant control and the next required verification, ownership, review, or policy…
- **Invite Admin**: Invite a user or location group to administer a Google Business Profile account or location.
- **List Admins** (read-only): Return administrators and their roles for a Google Business Profile account or location.
- **List Attribute Metadata** (read-only): Return one page of valid Google Business Profile attribute definitions for a location or a category and region, including value constraints.
- **List Invitations** (read-only): Return pending account invitations, optionally filtered by target type.
- **List Locations** (read-only): Return one page of Google Business Profile locations in an account, with the fields selected by read_mask and a cursor for the next page.
- **List Place Action Type Metadata** (read-only): Return one page of place-action types, such as appointment or food-ordering links, available for a Google Business Profile location or…
- **List Search Keyword Impressions** (read-only): Return one page of monthly search keyword impression counts for a Google Business Profile location and a cursor for the next page.
- **List Verification Options** (read-only): List the verification methods currently eligible for one Google Business Profile location in a requested language.
- **List Verifications** (read-only): Return one page of verification attempts and states for a Google Business Profile location, plus a cursor for the next page.
- **Remove Admin**: Permanently remove an administrator's access from a Google Business Profile account or location.
- **Search Google Locations** (read-only): Find an existing Google Maps location by free-form query or structured location data before creating or claiming a Business Profile.
- **Start Verification**: Start Google Business Profile verification with a method currently eligible for the location.
- **Transfer Location**: Transfer a Google Business Profile location to another account administered by the connected user.
- **Update Account**: Rename a non-personal Business Profile account.
- **Update Admin**: Change a Google Business Profile account or location administrator's role.
- **Update Food Menus**: Replace or update food-menu data for an eligible Google Business Profile location.
- **Update Local Post**: Update selected fields on an existing Google Business Profile local post.
- **Update Location**: Update selected merchant-managed fields on a Google Business Profile location.
- **Update Location Attributes**: Set or clear selected merchant-managed attributes on a Google Business Profile location.
- **Update Lodging**: Update selected lodging, amenity, policy, accessibility, service, or sustainability fields for a Google Business Profile hotel location.
- **Update Media**: Update the category association of merchant-owned Google Business Profile media.
- **Update Notification Setting**: Set or clear an account's Pub/Sub topic and replace its enabled Google Business Profile notification types.
- **Update Place Action Link**: Update a Google Business Profile place-action link's URL, action type, or preferred status.
- **Update Review Reply**: Create or replace a merchant reply to a Google Business Profile review.
- **Upload Location Media**: Upload a photo file and publish it on a Google Business Profile location in one operation.
